name: Luxshare Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Luxshare Precision Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of products in the fields of consumer electronics, communication, auto electronics, and healthcare in China and internationally. The company specializes in precision manufacturing solutions including components and modules, and systems for clients across consumer electronics, automotive electronics, communication and data centres, and other end markets. It engages in the production and sale of connecting cables, connectors, computer peripherals, and plastic and metal products worldwide.
